summary: The reported GLM-5.2 pipeline-parallel IndexError could not be reproduced on the prepared single AMD gfx950 host. The report requires GLM-5.2-FP8 weights and four pipeline stages on NVIDIA B300 GPUs; neither the weights nor matching hardware/topology were available. The current source has substantially reworked PP batch-state and output relay handling since the reported revision 2cbe1e6404144dc753de01525a51cbd7a89c1fda, including explicit per-microbatch planning and typed PP tensor messages, and focused result-normalization/communication tests pass. However, those facts do not establish that the intermittent GLM-5.2 PP=4 failure is fixed, so no speculative runtime change was made.

tests.what_was_measured: Decode-result normalization boundaries for ordinary/speculative grammar and hidden-state output; 13 tests and 2 subtests passed.
Scheduler receive/skip communication and independent batch-result boundary behavior; 9 tests and 2 subtests passed.
Weightless scripted PP scheduler fixture. It produced no test result within 133 seconds and was interrupted. This is inconclusive and is not a model, GPU, or full PP reproduction.
Environment inventory only: one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned gfx950 GPU was detected, but no issue-relevant GLM-5.2 model execution or four-stage pipeline execution was possible. CPU/unit and scripted-runtime checks must not be represented as GPU reproduction.

remaining_limitations: GLM-5.2-FP8 weights at the reporter's snapshot were unavailable.
Only one AMD MI350X/gfx950 GPU was assigned; the report uses four NVIDIA B300 GPUs with PP=4 and a custom 19,20,20,19 layer partition.
The failure is intermittent under production requests, and no exact triggering request was provided in the issue.
Passing focused tests and inspection of later PP refactors do not prove the original GLM-5.2 architecture/workload is fixed.
The weightless scripted PP test did not finish before interruption and therefore supplied no positive or negative reproduction result.
